entries.name: BunGoogleUSProxy
entries.arguments: ssh forward --system -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -o ServerAliveInterval=15 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 -L 127.0.0.1:1081:127.0.0.1:1081 vps
entries.description: Owner-scoped Bun SSH forward to existing independent Mullvad Google US namespace; loopback only
